semantic_event_mapping.JUMP: native JUMP records a grounded impulse accepted at the current fixed tick
semantic_event_mapping.LAND: native LAND records crossing onto a platform top
semantic_event_mapping.COLLIDE: native COLLIDE records ceiling contact or checkpoint recovery
semantic_event_mapping.CHECKPOINT: native CHECKPOINT records explicit checkpoint capture

assumptions: player_start is interpreted as an initial foot anchor; runtime stores player position at the capsule top-center.
If the initial capsule overlaps a platform, it is lifted to clear the intersecting platform using the declared capsule radius and height; spawn coordinates and physics constants are not changed.
Capsule radius is 0.35 and height is 1.
Fixed-step physics uses gravity 0.035, horizontal speed 0.18, and jump impulse 0.34.
Fall below y=-4 or leave the horizontal recovery range restores the checkpoint through the same overlap resolver.
LAND is emitted only when changing from airborne to grounded.
This is a bounded task-specific physics model, not a registered runtime.
Source and usage budgets are unverified.
